title: Pixel-art cobblestone path with grass joints
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art cobblestone or sett path at a chosen art resolution: outlined superellipse stones from round cobbles to square setts, shaded from a top-left light, with grass tufts or dirt in the joints and wet glints, plus per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for 2D roads.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_cobblestone_path.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: stones
parameters.meaning: Stones across the tile (and rows down it).

parameters.name: roundness
parameters.meaning: Stone shape: 0 square setts, 1 round cobbles.

parameters.name: stone_size
parameters.meaning: Stone size as a share of its cell; neighbours never overlap, larger values close the joints.

parameters.name: jitter
parameters.meaning: Random offset and size variation of the stones.

parameters.name: grass
parameters.meaning: Share of the joints grown with grass instead of bare dirt.

parameters.name: wet
parameters.meaning: Wetness: lower roughness and glints on the stones.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Grey round cobbles with grass growing between them.

presets.name: sandstone_setts
presets.description: Warm square sandstone setts in offset rows with sandy joints.

presets.name: wet_night
presets.description: Dark wet cobbles with glints and muddy joints.

presets.name: mossy_path
presets.description: Old green-grey cobbles sunk in moss.

limits: Stylized pixel art with the light from the top left baked into the stone shading. Stones sit on a jittered grid, one per cell, so the layout stays orderly; there are no curved courses or fan patterns. Shapes are superellipses with a dome height. Wetness lowers roughness and adds glints but draws no puddles or reflections. The normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Jittered grid with half-stone row offset on a torus
Superellipse distance blending square and round stones
Nearest-shape ownership among the nine neighbouring cells
Tone selection from the offset along a light direction
